newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai foreign investment $7.17 bln Jan-Aug.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai foreign investment $7.17 bln Jan-Aug.

text.p: Contracted foreign investment in Shanghai in the first eight months of 1996 was $7.17 billion, an increase of six percent over the same 1995 period, the Financial News reported on Wednesday.

The number of projects in the period was 1,437, a fall of nearly 33 percent, it said, indicating a larger investment sum per project -- $4.98 million in the period, up from $3.27 million in the same 1995 period, it said.
Investments in industry, real estate and public utilities accounted for 93 percent, it said.
Investment from Japan in the eight-month period was $1.2 billion, an increase of 30 percent over the same 1995 period, making Japan the second biggest foreign investor in the city after Hong Kong.
Total Japanese investment in the city at end-August was $4.5 billion, it said but gave no more details.
